segments.name: Digital
segments.description: Comprises SLB's industry-leading digital solutions and data products for the energy industry.
segments.evidence: Digital – Comprised of SLB's industry-leading digital solutions and data products.

segments.name: Reservoir Performance
segments.description: Provides reservoir-centric technologies and services critical to optimizing reservoir productivity and performance.
segments.evidence: Reservoir Performance – Consists of reservoir-centric technologies and services that are critical to optimizing reservoir productivity and performance.

segments.name: Well Construction
segments.description: Combines the full portfolio of products and services to optimize well placement, drilling efficiency and wellbore assurance.
segments.evidence: Well Construction – Combines the full portfolio of products and services to optimize well placement and performance, maximize drilling efficiency, and improve wellbore assurance.

segments.name: Production Systems
segments.description: Develops technologies and expertise that enhance production and recovery of oil and gas assets from subsurface reservoirs to surface, pipelines and refineries.
segments.evidence: Production Systems – Develops technologies and provides expertise that enhances production and recovery of oil and gas assets from subsurface reservoirs to the surface, into pipelines, and to refineries.

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Consists of Asset Performance Solutions, Data Center Solutions, and SLB Capturi businesses.
segments.evidence: All Other – Consists of Asset Performance Solutions, Data Center Solutions, and SLB Capturi.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily in the oil and gas industry, pay SLB for services provided and products sold, with revenue based on the location where services are provided and products are sold.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is based on the location where services are provided and products are sold.

changes.text: In 2025, SLB began reporting its Digital business as a separate Division.
changes.evidence: Commencing the third quarter of 2025, SLB's Digital business is reported as a separate Division.

changes.text: In 2025, Asset Performance Solutions, Data Center Solutions and SLB Capturi were moved to the All Other category.
changes.evidence: Additionally, SLB's Asset Performance Solutions ("APS"), Data Center Solutions and SLB Capturi businesses are now reported in the All Other category.

changes.text: In 2025, the acquired ChampionX businesses were reported predominantly in the Production Systems Division, with its digital business in the Digital Division.
changes.evidence: The acquired ChampionX businesses are predominantly reported in SLB's Production Systems Division, with the exception of its digital business, which is reported in SLB's Digital Division.
